programs.title: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
programs.desc: For over a decade, Stephen Colbert hosted a late-night show where comedy, politics, and culture collided nightly; explore how he shaped an era of American satire and the impact of one of its most thoughtful voices signing off.

programs.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown
programs.desc: On April 26, 1986, a massive explosion rips through a reactor during a safety test at a power plant in Ukraine, triggering the worst nuclear accident in history; within 24 hours, a lethal radioactive cloud starts to circle the globe.

programs.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown
programs.desc: The day after the incident, helicopter crews brave deadly radioactive smoke to extinguish the fire raging in the reactor core. As 50,000 locals evacuate, Soviet authorities try to conceal the scale and human cost of the accident.

programs.title: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown
programs.desc: In the weeks following the meltdown, workers battle lethal radiation to clear debris and construct a protective tomb around the destroyed reactor. Amid speculation, Soviet scientists reveal what they can about the cause of the catastrophe.
